title: "What AI am I using? 🤖"
paragraphs: People keep asking me if I use AI to answer questions and write blogs. My answer? Yes! It's called 'Anointed Intelligence'—powered by daily Bible study, the Holy Spirit, and non-stop prayer! 🙌

The tools I use?
📖 The Expositor’s Study Bible – for deep insights
💻 eSword software – because even preachers need digital tools
🌐 Google – but with discernment, because not everything online is gospel truth!
🎨 Perchance.org/ai-photo-generator  & Canva – for images, because even posts should glorify God beautifully!
Everything I use is free and available to everyone—no secrets, no gimmicks, just prayer and wisdom from God (James 1:5). 🙏
So before relying on AI, try relying on the Almighty first. His wisdom never glitches, never lags, and is always updated! 🤭
"But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you." – Matthew 6:33
You can download the esword here for free ;) https://e-sword.net/
